bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/compression.rs (encode_buffer, encode_buffer_threaded, decode_buffer, decode_buffer_limited, Stream, InputFilter, OutputFilter), springboard/sdk/src/compression/dynamic.rs (Level, encode, encode_threaded), springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/inflate.rs (inflate, zlib), springboard/src/files/zip.rs (create, extract), springboard/src/pngenc.rs (zlib_stored)
summary: BifrOSt has DEFLATE and zlib encoding and decoding for apps through bifrost_app::compression, with a dynamic-Huffman encoder at three levels and an optional thread count for large inputs, and streams and filters that run on finalize. It has no LZFSE, LZ4, LZMA or Brotli codecs, no incremental codec state, and no compression for the Files app zip writer or the PNG writer.

features.note: DEFLATE and zlib only; takes a Level and a thread count; returns a Vec, so no scratch buffer. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-20 zlib_header_second_byte_follows_the_level, zlib_trailer_is_the_big_endian_adler32_of_the_input, threads_change_the_bytes_but_never_the_decoded_data, every_codec_and_level_round_trips_every_sample; parity_sdk-tests-04 every_level_and_algorithm_round_trips, zlib_header_flevel_follows_the_level, zlib_trailer_is_the_adler32_of_the_input, one_thread_gives_the_same_bytes_as_the_single_step_call. Not yet verified on Midget.

DEFLATE and zlib only; output is capped at inflate::MAX_OUT (256 MiB) or a caller-given limit. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-20 the_reference_zlib_bytes_decode_to_hello, the_decode_limit_is_inclusive_and_one_byte_less_refuses, a_deflate_stream_cut_short_is_truncated, zlib_header_with_a_method_other_than_deflate_is_invalid; parity_sdk-tests-04 zlib_reference_bytes_decode_to_hello, decode_limit_is_inclusive_and_refuses_one_byte_more, decode_reports_truncated_input. Not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: compression_algorithm, Algorithm (LZFSE, LZ4, LZ4_RAW, LZMA, ZLIB)
features.note: Algorithm cases exist for LZFSE, LZ4, LZBITMAP, LZMA and Brotli but fail with Unsupported; Zlib and Deflate are implemented. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-20 only_zlib_and_raw_deflate_are_supported, unsupported_algorithms_are_named_in_every_buffer_and_stream_entry_point; parity_sdk-tests-04 unsupported_algorithms_fail_in_every_entry_point. Not yet verified on Midget.

A compress stream returns each block as soon as 65535 bytes of input are in, and a decompress stream returns output as soon as each symbol completes. The decoder is a resumable state machine (compression/inflate_stream.rs) that rolls back a unit needing more input. Output does not depend on how the input is split into writes. Still missing: no flush call, so a short tail waits for finalize. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-20 a_compress_stream_returns_full_blocks_before_it_is_finalized, a_decompress_stream_accepts_the_input_in_pieces, a_finalized_stream_refuses_more_input, a_decompress_stream_reports_bad_input_as_soon_as_it_arrives; inline compression.rs a_compress_stream_emits_full_blocks_before_finalize, a_compress_stream_gives_the_one_shot_bytes_for_any_split, a_decompress_stream_takes_one_byte_at_a_time, a_truncated_decompress_stream_fails_at_finalize_and_then_is_finished; inline inflate_stream.rs one_byte_at_a_time_matches_the_whole_input. Not yet verified on Midget.

The input filter asks its source for capacity-sized pieces, and only as far as the reader needs. The output filter sends output as each write completes it. Bad input fails the call that reaches it, and later reads fail the same way. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-20 an_input_filter_serves_the_decoded_data_in_requested_sizes, an_input_filter_drains_its_source_in_buffer_sized_requests (the source is asked for capacity-sized pieces), an_input_filter_failure_is_sticky, an_output_filter_delivers_the_result_in_chunks_of_the_capacity, an_output_filter_refuses_writes_and_a_second_finalize_after_finishing, an_output_filter_leaves_the_sink_untouched_when_the_data_is_invalid; inline compression.rs input_filter_pulls_input_only_as_far_as_the_reader_needs, output_filter_reports_bad_input_on_the_write_that_has_it. Not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: compression_decode_buffer with ZLIB or raw DEFLATE
features.note: Decoder written out for the Books engine and exposed through the SDK module; no crate. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-20 the_reference_raw_deflate_bytes_decode_to_hello, a_deflate_stream_cut_short_is_truncated; parity_sdk-tests-04 raw_deflate_reference_bytes_decode_to_hello, decode_rejects_a_reserved_block_type, decode_reports_truncated_input. Not yet verified on Midget.

Lazy LZ77 (one byte of lookahead) at Default and Best, greedy at Fast, over a 32 KiB window, with dynamic Huffman blocks. A block is written stored when that is smaller than the Huffman form. The levels set the chain depth. Still missing: no optimal parsing, and each block has its own tables only. Tests: inline dynamic.rs lazy_levels_round_trip_and_are_deterministic, incompressible_input_is_stored_within_five_bytes_per_block, streamed_output_does_not_depend_on_the_write_sizes; parity_sdk-tests-20 repetitive_text_compresses_far_below_its_size_at_every_level. The Files app zip writer still uses its own fixed-Huffman encoder (springboard/src/files/zip.rs:331). Not yet verified on Midget.

zlib_compressed codes PNG output with a fixed-Huffman deflate block and LZ77 back references; headless tests in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-complete-43.rs decode the output with the png crate. Gap: there are no dynamic Huffman blocks and no compression levels.

Decode failures are reported by the call that sees them (write, process or read), not only at finalize. The encode side can fail only with Unsupported at init; writes after finalize report Finished or InvalidState. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-20 error_messages_name_each_failure, zlib_header_whose_check_bits_do_not_divide_by_31_is_invalid, zlib_header_that_asks_for_a_preset_dictionary_is_invalid, a_decompress_stream_reports_bad_input_as_soon_as_it_arrives, an_output_filter_leaves_the_sink_untouched_when_the_data_is_invalid; inline compression.rs output_filter_reports_bad_input_on_the_write_that_has_it, a_truncated_decompress_stream_fails_at_finalize_and_then_is_finished. Not yet verified on Midget.

App-facing module for buffers, streams and filters. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-20 (imports bifrost_app::compression and checks buffer, stream and filter results); parity_sdk-tests-04 (every test in the file uses bifrost_app::compression, for example zlib_reference_bytes_decode_to_hello and compress_stream_returns_everything_on_the_finalizing_call). Not yet verified on Midget.
tied to Apple's C buffer API; Rust Vec output needs no scratch size

gaps: No LZFSE, LZ4, LZ4_RAW, LZMA or Brotli codec in either direction
No incremental stream state (init, process, destroy): streams buffer their input and run on finalize
DEFLATE encoder has no lazy matching; output is larger than zlib at the same level
PNG writer stores uncompressed zlib blocks (springboard/src/pngenc.rs:31), not deflate-compressed
Files app zip writer does not use the SDK encoder yet, so its archives are fixed-Huffman
